title: Dashboard fetch: route -> handler -> service call path
answers: How does an HTTP request reach a services/ implementation?
What is the call path for GetDashboard?
How do services get wired into the API layer?
body: For a GET dashboard-by-uid request: `pkg/api/api.go:467` registers `dashboardRoute.Get("/uid/:uid", authorize(...), routing.Wrap(hs.GetDashboard))` → `pkg/api/dashboard.go:69 GetDashboard` calls `pkg/api/dashboard.go:283 getDashboardHelper` → `hs.DashboardService.GetDashboard(ctx, &dashboards.GetDashboardQuery{...})`. `HTTPServer` holds the interface field `pkg/api/http_server.go:190 DashboardService dashboards.DashboardService`, injected via wire. The concrete implementation is `pkg/services/dashboards/service/dashboard_service.go:DashboardServiceImpl`. Services also self-register as background workers via `Run(ctx) error` satisfying `pkg/registry/registry.go:BackgroundService` (e.g. `dashboard_service.go:386` asserted at `dashboard_service.go:395`), driven by `pkg/server/server.go` through `registry.BackgroundServiceRegistry.GetServices()`.
